completenessNote: 全文，共 8 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (Aviation Industry — Class Licence) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 1 July 2025.

heading.en: Application to aircraft on certain flights only
Prohibited guns, etc., not covered by class licence
Pilot‑in‑command of certain flights is class licensee

text.en: 5. Unless exempt by or under section 87 or 88 of the Act and subject to section 66(1) and (2)(c) of the Act, every pilot‑in‑command of an aircraft mentioned in paragraph 3 is subject to a class licence authorising the pilot‑in‑command to have possession while in Singapore, and to import and export, any controlled item of the aircraft.

heading.en: Passenger and crew member are class licensee

text.en: 7. Unless exempt by or under section 87 or 88 of the Act and subject to section 66(1) and (2)(c) of the Act, every passenger, and every member of the crew, of an aircraft mentioned in paragraph 3 are subject to a class licence authorising the passenger or crew of the aircraft to have possession while in Singapore, and to import and export, any controlled item of the aircraft.

heading.en: Conditions of passenger or crew, etc., class licence

text.en:
8. A class licensee by virtue of paragraph 7 may possess, and import and export, any controlled item of the aircraft subject to all the following conditions:
(a)the class licensee discloses, in writing, to the pilot‑in‑command of the aircraft, and within the time delimited in paragraph 2(2) before or upon arriving in Singapore —
(i)the type or description of every controlled item of the aircraft in the possession of the class licensee; and
(ii)the total number of controlled items of the aircraft in the possession of the class licensee, according to type or description; and
(b)the class licensee takes all reasonable precautions to ensure that no controlled item of the aircraft —
(i)is knowingly or negligently abandoned in Singapore; or
(ii)is transferred, or allowed to be transferred, in Singapore to the possession of another person except a permissible custodian;
(c)the class licensee takes all reasonable precautions to ensure that each controlled item of the aircraft is stored or kept according to acceptable storage requirements during the interval between the aircraft arriving in Singapore and then leaving Singapore, so that the controlled item will not be used or handled by a person who is not authorised by or under the Act to possess or handle it during that interval;
(d)the class licensee takes all reasonable precautions to ensure that any gun that is a controlled item of the aircraft is and remains unloaded at all times during the interval mentioned in sub‑paragraph (c).
